text: 1. Hold a master diploma 2. Be in good health 3. Within the age bracket of 18-45 years old (students under 18 years old only can apply if you have guarantor in China) 4. With a Chinese proficiency level of HSK 5 or above (HSK 7 for Arts students) 5. On passing the exams set by the university in accordance with the program chosen, the applicants can be admitted to do a bachelor's degree program at the university.
